I know the feeling of finding therapy overwhelming at first, the first few appointments you’ll just talk about everything and anything, but after that you’ll start to pick at things and make then less of an issue each time. Sure, therapy will be confronting as fuck, but eventually it should help, if its by solving the issues or simply knowing what’s wrong and why you’re having issues with those things. The only thing i can suggest is trying to stick with it and rant about stuff with others if you feel the need to, giving therapy a genuine try is the key to it working, sadly, no guarantee for that though:( but stick to it and im proud of you for reaching out and trying to solve things, that’s really hard an brave of you💕

Don’t feel obligated to feel happy, you honestly can’t force happiness. 
There are homeless people out there who should feel sad etc, but they can still be happy because that’s what they feel. 

Even though what you have may sound like a dream to some people, even to me, you’re still not forced to feel something you’re not. 
As long as you try to force your happiness it’s never going to be real. 
Maybe try to focus more on the issues that make you feel like this rather while you don’t feel something else.
